criterion: AP paired calendar-quarter bootstrap lower bound > 0 for every seed; Brier/ECE tradeoffs shown separately
limits: First observed same-cell sample 14–17 days later; Karenia brevis >= 100000 cells/L. 0.1 degree cells; sampled-target prediction, not continuous daily bloom forecast. Sample availability assumed at collection; no publication-latency archive.
calibration: Separate pre-test chronological window; empirical conformal coverage not an IID guarantee.
